reviews.comment: Great teacher, even better person. Makes class super enjoyable and helps students in every way possible.

Guys its literally a couple short papers (like career plans or a resume draft) and some easy weekly quizzes so easy 100 cause its basically completion grade. He will roast people's resumes and stuff in class which can be funny and helpful but if you don't want yours to be publicly shat on then let him know beforehand! Really funny and blunt dude.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I genuinely enjoyed attending his lectures! Easy A if you do the assignments, which only took 5 minutes to finish. I learned a lot about GIS related jobs and internships which would definitely help me in the future. I HIGHLY recommend taking Prof Goldberg and this class!

took this as one of my elective classes and absolutely loved it! It is basically a class to help you be more prepared for life outside of college like internships,emails,business cards,tips for interviewing etc.- I really really recommend taking this class if your studying something in the geography department
